title: Scaffold Weekly Inspection
name: Scaffold Weekly Inspection
description: Recorded scaffold inspection covering foundations, standards, ledgers, bracing, ties, platforms, access, edge protection, loading and unauthorised alteration.

fields.label: Weather / Relevant Change Since Last Inspection

sections.title: FOUNDATION / STRUCTURE / TIES
items: Foundations, base plates and sole boards remain sound and correctly supported
Standards, ledgers, transoms and bracing are secure and undamaged
Ties and anchors remain in place and suitable
No unauthorised alteration or removed component is evident
Loading remains within the scaffold design / class

sections.title: PLATFORMS / EDGE PROTECTION / ACCESS
items: Working platforms are fully boarded / decked and secure
Guardrails and toe boards are complete where required
Gaps, traps and openings are adequately controlled
Ladders / stair access are secure and unobstructed
Access points and scaffold tags / signs are clear

sections.title: HOUSEKEEPING / INTERFACES
items: Platforms are free from excessive debris and unsafe stored materials
Sheeting, netting or fans remain secure
Vehicle, crane, hoist or adjacent-work interfaces remain controlled
Electrical / overhead-line hazards remain controlled where applicable
Changes in weather or site conditions have not made the scaffold unsafe

fields.label: Inspection Result
options: PASS - scaffold remains available for use
RESTRICTIONS - use only with stated controls
FAIL - scaffold not to be used
